description: Rise and Be Recognized <Warmaster Laggrond salutes you.> It is your time, <name>. You have done much for the Frostwolf Clan and in doing so, earned a place as not only a soldier of Frostwolf but also as a friend. Well done! Present your initiate's insignia. Requirements: - Frostwolf Insignia Rank 1
name: Rise and Be Recognized
